seo.title: Patient Reviews
seo.description: What patients have said about their care at ProDenta, a private dental practice in Battersea.

heading: Patient reviews
intro: A few of the things patients have told us after their treatment.

reviews.name: Katy Williams
reviews.quote: Fantastic experience. They really take the time to explain the treatments and make you feel relaxed.

reviews.name: Samantha
reviews.quote: Confident and experienced dentist who takes the time to sit down with you and explain treatments fully.

reviews.name: Ruth
reviews.quote: Shubhra is excellent, knowledgeable and friendly.

reviews.name: Victoria
reviews.quote: Excellent, extremely friendly private dentist practice.

reviews.name: David
reviews.quote: The impact has been just brilliant. I just feel fantastic every day.

reviews.name: Matt
reviews.quote: I just wanted to say thanks as my gums seem to be much better now you taught me that new brushing technique.

reviews.name: Kathy
reviews.quote: My teeth look fabulous. So pleased with your work.

reviews.name: Charlie
reviews.quote: I love my new white teeth, thank you so much. I have had lots of comments today.
